title: Trace-free exchange/projection reordering on the self-product
statement: Let l be prime, c a finite rational coefficient or its algebraic closure, k of characteristic p distinct from l, and Y a k-scheme. Put q:P1_Y→Y, W=P1_Y×Y P1_Y, T=Lambda_P(1)[2], F=q*, R=Rq*, and H=(-)(1)[2]. For any derived K, let nu=R(tensorShiftIso.inv) followed by inverse projection_q(K,T). Let beta:F(R T)→Rp2*(T_W) be canonical exchange followed by the first shifted-line comparison. Define S_K,V:H(FK) tensor F(V)≅H(F(K tensor V)) explicitly by tensorShiftIso, associativity, the native Koszul symmetry and the monoidal tensorator of F. Assuming projection_q(K,T), beta, exchange at H(FK), and its twisted p2 projection are invertible, J_K followed by unitTail and H(F(nu)) equals (identity_H(FK) tensor inverse beta) followed by S_K,RT. All maps are those of [def-sfb-rational-p1-second-pull-comparison], [def-sfb-rational-p1-ambient-tail] and [def-sfb-projective-ambient-unit-counit-composites]. No counit trace or completed reference occurs.

source.place: Second identity: extraction of q*K and cancellation of the projection, before applying a trace.

proof.text: Set V=Rq*(T) and z=beta in the forward two-factor projection identity. Rewrite its middle composite by the forward exchange/projection square. This yields S ; H(F(projection_q) ; F(R(tensorShiftIso.hom)) ; exchange_M) ; twistProjection = (identity_M tensor beta) ; J.

Apply the categorical inverse-square cancellation to this equality. The witnesses hq,hb,hp,hx make the pulled q projection, exchange_M, twisted p2 projection, and identity_M tensor beta invertible. Cancel each forward arrow against its specified inverse, including the tensorShiftIso pair. Functoriality identifies the remaining inverse composite with unitTail followed by H(F(counitProjectionPart)). Inverse tensor whiskering gives the stated identity_M tensor inverse beta followed by S. Package the resulting SecondPretraceEquation with abstract coefficient and exchanged-object variables before specializing to the rational coefficient. This is the proved generic_record_assembly interface step; it adds no hypothesis.

    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]

    (hq : IsIso (projectionMap (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) K

        0).obj (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y))) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)))
    (hx : IsIso (secondTraceExchange l c k p hpl Y)) :
    SecondPretraceEquation (coefficient l c).X Y (line l c)
      (secondLineComparison l c k p hpl Y)
      ((twist (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y) (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y))).obj
        ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj K))
      ((twist (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y) (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y))).obj

                (ProjectiveLine Y)) 0).obj (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y))) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))))
      ((moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (secondProjection Y)).obj
        (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules (coefficient l c).X (diagonalSurface Y))
          0).obj (line l c (diagonalSurface Y))) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))
      ((moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj
        (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y))
          0).obj (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y))) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))
      ((twist (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y) (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y))).map
        ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).map
          (counitProjectionPart (coefficient l c).X Y (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y)) K hq)))
      (@inv _ _ _ _ (secondTraceExchange l c k p hpl Y) hx)
      (secondTraceStrength (coefficient l c).X Y (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y)) K
        ((moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj
          (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y))
            0).obj (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y))) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))).hom
